cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5.0)
project(core_napi)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

# Generated by package_har.sh (CORE_A_PATH / CORE_INCLUDE).
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/core_paths.cmake")
  include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/core_paths.cmake")
endif()

if(NOT DEFINED CORE_A_PATH OR NOT EXISTS "${CORE_A_PATH}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "CORE_A_PATH missing. Run package_har.sh / build_ohos.sh first.")
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED CORE_INCLUDE OR NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${CORE_INCLUDE}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "CORE_INCLUDE missing.")
endif()

add_library(core_napi SHARED napi_init.cpp)
target_include_directories(core_napi PRIVATE "${CORE_INCLUDE}")
target_link_libraries(core_napi PUBLIC "${CORE_A_PATH}" libace_napi.z.so)
